chunks: And those who recite the Reminder,

key_terms.ذِكْرًا: The Reminder (referring to the Quran or divine remembrance)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be among those who recite the Reminder?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase is often linked to the continuous recitation of the Quran and the remembrance of God, emphasizing the spiritual discipline of the faithful. It underscores the importance of maintaining a constant connection with the Divine through both vocal recitation (tilawah) and internal reflection (dhikr), serving as a means of purifying the soul and drawing closer to Allah.
